title: A look at React, Angular and Svelte, from where Vue stands

videos.script:
This is the last lesson, and it leaves Vue on purpose. {{card}} You will build one small card four times: a course's week, with a box to tick and a total. First in Vue, then in React, Angular and Svelte, each made by its own tool.

{{react}} React, where the component is a function that runs again on every change. {{angular}} Angular, a whole platform, with signals that are close kin of Vue's refs, and an audit report that, this time, is worth acting on. {{svelte}} Svelte, a compiler, where a plain variable becomes reactive.

{{compare}} Then the four side by side. A line of console in each card shows what runs again at a tick, and the builds show what each one sends to the browser. {{transfers}} And last, what you take from this course to any of the others, which turns out to be most of it.
